properties.name: Merced River
properties.description: Wild and scenic river carving Yosemite Valley beneath El Capitan and Half Dome, then plunging through the Merced River canyon.

properties.name: Tuolumne River
properties.description: Flows from Lyell Glacier through Tuolumne Meadows and the Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne into Hetch Hetchy.

properties.name: American River
properties.description: Lower American River Parkway from Folsom to the Sacramento River confluence.

properties.name: North Fork American River
properties.description: Wild & scenic canyon river; spring whitewater on the Chamberlain Falls run.

properties.name: Middle Fork American River
properties.description: Remote canyon river below Oxbow Reservoir; the Tunnel Chute whitewater run.

properties.name: South Fork American River
properties.description: California's most-rafted river: Chili Bar and the Gorge run through Coloma's gold country.

properties.name: Sacramento River
properties.description: California's largest river; 400 miles from Mount Shasta's springs through the Central Valley to the Delta.

properties.name: McCloud River
properties.description: Spring-fed river with the three McCloud Falls and legendary wild trout fishing.

properties.name: Pit River
properties.description: Volcanic-plateau river fed by Burney and Hat Creeks, flowing into Shasta Lake.

properties.name: Feather River
properties.description: Deep Sierra canyons of the Feather River Scenic Byway and the wild & scenic Middle Fork.

properties.name: Yuba River
properties.description: Emerald swimming holes of the South Yuba and the Highway 49 corridor through Downieville.

properties.name: Truckee River
properties.description: Lake Tahoe's only outlet, floated from Tahoe City and running east through Reno to Pyramid Lake.

properties.name: Carson River
properties.description: Hope Valley and the East Fork hot-springs float through the Carson-Iceberg country.

properties.name: Mokelumne River
properties.description: Gold-country river from the Mokelumne Wilderness to the Delta.

properties.name: Stanislaus River
properties.description: Calaveras Big Trees' river and the canyons below Sonora Pass.

properties.name: San Joaquin River
properties.description: Born near Thousand Island Lake and Devils Postpile; drains the southern High Sierra into the Central Valley.

properties.name: Kings River
properties.description: Carved the deepest canyon in North America through Kings Canyon NP.

properties.name: Kaweah River
properties.description: Sequoia NP's steep river system tumbling from the Great Western Divide.

properties.name: Kern River
properties.description: Wild & scenic river running due south through the Kern Canyon fault from Mount Whitney country.

properties.name: Owens River
properties.description: Central artery of the Eastern Sierra valley floor along US-395; world-class fly fishing.

properties.name: Big Pine Creek
properties.description: Glacier-fed mountain stream gushing turquoise snowmelt down from Palisade Glacier and Temple Crag.

properties.name: Russian River
properties.description: Winds through redwood groves and wine country to the Pacific at Jenner; classic summer canoe trips.

properties.name: Lagunitas Creek
properties.description: Marin's coastal stream through Samuel P. Taylor; largest wild coho salmon run in central California.

properties.name: Pescadero Creek
properties.description: Redwood creek through Portola and Memorial parks to the Pescadero marsh.

properties.name: San Lorenzo River
properties.description: Henry Cowell's redwood river flowing to the Santa Cruz boardwalk.

properties.name: Big Sur River
properties.description: Ventana Wilderness river past Sykes Hot Springs and Pfeiffer Big Sur to Molera Beach.

properties.name: Carmel River
properties.description: Santa Lucia Range river reaching the sea at Carmel River State Beach.

properties.name: Salinas River
properties.description: Steinbeck country's 'upside-down' river flowing north to Monterey Bay.

properties.name: Navarro River
properties.description: Redwood-lined river from Hendy Woods through Anderson Valley to the Mendocino coast.

properties.name: Eel River
properties.description: Avenue of the Giants' river through Humboldt Redwoods State Park.

properties.name: Trinity River
properties.description: Wild & scenic river below Trinity Lake; salmon, steelhead and summer rafting on Highway 299.

properties.name: Klamath River
properties.description: Undammed since 2024: wild & scenic river through the Klamath Mountains to the redwood coast.

properties.name: Smith River
properties.description: California's last major undammed river, with emerald pools beneath Jedediah Smith's redwoods.

properties.name: Burney Creek
properties.description: Spring-fed creek emerging from lava tubes to feed the 129-foot Burney Falls.
